body.ruleText:
rule dac_gh_0022 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "GitHub: Org SAML SSO enforcement disabled - org.disable_saml / sso_policy weaken"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-GH-0022"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1556.006"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    (($e.metadata.product_event_type = "org.disable_saml" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "org.update_saml_provider_settings" nocase) or $e.metadata.product_event_type = /^business\.sso_/ nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
